Consider each matrix below and determine if it is in reduced row echelon form. If not, indicate the reason and apply a sequence of row operations to find its reduced row echelon matrix. For each matrix, indicate whether the corresponding linear system has infinitely many solutions, exactly one solution, or no solutions.

$$ \left[ \begin{array}{rrrr|r} 1 \amp 1 \amp 0 \amp 3 \amp 3 \\ 0 \amp 1 \amp 0 \amp -2 \amp 1 \\ 0 \amp 0 \amp 1 \amp 3 \amp 4 \\ \end{array} \right] $$

$$ \left[ \begin{array}{rrrr|r} 1 \amp 0 \amp 0 \amp 0 \amp 0 \\ 0 \amp 2 \amp 0 \amp 0 \amp 0 \\ 0 \amp 0 \amp -3 \amp 0 \amp 0 \\ 0 \amp 0 \amp 0 \amp 1 \amp 0 \\ 0 \amp 0 \amp 0 \amp 0 \amp 1 \\ \end{array} \right] $$

$$ \left[ \begin{array}{rrrr|r} 1 \amp 0 \amp 0 \amp 3 \amp 3 \\ 0 \amp 1 \amp 0 \amp -2 \amp 1 \\ 0 \amp 0 \amp 1 \amp 3 \amp 4 \\ 0 \amp 0 \amp 0 \amp 3 \amp 3 \\ \end{array} \right] $$

$$ \left[ \begin{array}{rrrr|r} 0 \amp 0 \amp 1 \amp 0 \amp -1 \\ 0 \amp 1 \amp 0 \amp 0 \amp 3 \\ 1 \amp 1 \amp 1 \amp 1 \amp 2 \\ \end{array} \right] $$
